decision: The dock rack stays rigidly bolted across the open front of the gantry U (no independent lift). The printer change is recorded instead: the bed's front edge moves behind the parked envelope. No rack, dock, tool, carriage or gantry geometry changes.

required_printer_change.option_a_cut_or_custom_bed: Bed plate, heater and build sheet spanning Y40..359 (350 x 319 mm).
required_printer_change.option_b_shift_stock_bed: Keep the 350 x 350 bed, heater and sheet; move the bed and its mounts back 31 mm to Y40..390.
required_printer_change.build_sheet: No tab or overhang at the front edge.

frame.note: Nominal frame, panels and door from 01_Voron24_350_Frame_and_Enclosure as world bounding boxes (conservative for the extrusion profiles). No Z drives, bed supports or bed wiring are modeled.

print_area_and_probe.klipper_note: The coils sit behind the nozzle in printer Y (Y grows toward the rear). The README's probe snippets give y_offset -19.50 / -19.82; in printer coordinates these look sign-flipped (+19.50 / +19.82). Confirm with a probe-accuracy test before meshing.

summary.space_below_nearest_frame_note: Bay-0 dock front (Y-38) to the door-buffer plane (Y-40): the existing 2 mm front gap, the same at every gantry height and unchanged by the bed.

limitations: Rigid CAD envelopes at the revision-21 parked tools and docks; the revision-33 toolheads keep the same docking interface and lower envelope but the full ten-tool rack has not been re-audited with them.
The model has no Z drives, bed supports, bed wiring or nozzle brush. Check the space in front of the new bed edge, from Y-38 to the edge and down to 16 mm below the bed top, on the real printer.
No thermal expansion, bed mesh, gantry sag or QGL residual is included; the 4.6 mm edge gap covers them in Y, which is the only direction that matters for this clearance.
Klipper coordinates, probe offsets and the bed mesh limits must be commissioned on the machine.
